stem.text: Which description is correct for xylem vessel elements?

A.text: cells joined to form a tube, pits at intervals, sieve plates between cells, surrounded by the endodermis in roots

B.text: contains cells joined end to end, containing cytoplasm, cell walls with lignin, located to the outside of phloem in vascular bundles

C.text: contains elongated cells with end walls broken down, located in vascular bundles in the stem and centrally in the roots

D.text: dead elongated cells, lignified cell walls with pits at intervals, associated with companion cells in the roots only
